_comment: RISK ORACLE (RISK-05): evaluator-only labels for RS01-RS06. These labels, the seed sets, and any scenario name revealing a label NEVER enter scorer input: the scorer reads feature snapshots + mock signals only. Dev/calibration/final-test seed sets are disjoint with disjoint synthetic actor histories (features scope to run_id); the final set below froze before thresholds were chosen (UNUSUAL_RATIO 5.0, SIMULATED_BLOCK 9500000). RULES_PLUS_MOCK validates the harness only; it proves no Jev accuracy.

rs01.title: Benign normal and benign unusual activity

expect.note: first-in-run holds NEW_RECIPIENT; the rest complete

rs02.title: Labeled suspicious velocity or conflicting context
rs02.labelRule: index%4==3 (huge amount) is suspicious; all others benign

expect.note: huge amounts hold UNUSUAL_AMOUNT; 8M < 9.5M block so none reject

rs03.title: HTTP retries and MQ redeliveries
rs03.labelRule: repeats are benign duplicates, never fraud evidence

expect.note: retries create no rows; redelivery reuses the cached assessment

rs04.title: Missing, contradictory or adversarial memo text
rs04.labelRule: injected payloads are invalid input, not instructions

expect.note: no memo field exists: unknown JSON properties 400 before persistence; policy, labels, and destinations unaltered

rs05.title: Provider timeout, invalid type, rate limit or wrong model
rs05.labelRule: faulted evaluations are NOT_ASSESSED holds, operator-visible

rs06.title: Restart around assessment save / hold commit
rs06.labelRule: the single instruction holds exactly once across the restart
